blueprint.name: IBM ROKS Existing Cluster Registration
blueprint.description: Reference an existing IBM ROKS cluster and emit BNK registration outputs.

outcomes: An existing IBM ROKS cluster is referenced by name or ID
Cluster outputs are available for BNK managed-cluster registration

prerequisites.description: The modules/roks-cluster-register deployment pack from this repository must already be synced into Forge.

prerequisites.name: ibmcloud_api_key
prerequisites.description: Provide an IBM Cloud credential template or project secret that can supply the IBM Cloud API key.

input_summary.label: Input guidance
input_summary.value: Provide IBM Cloud API key, region, resource group, and the existing ROKS cluster name or ID.

required.name: ibmcloud_api_key
required.description: IBM Cloud API key for cluster discovery.

required.name: ibmcloud_cluster_region
required.description: IBM Cloud region where the existing ROKS cluster resides.

required.name: roks_cluster_name_or_id
required.description: Existing IBM ROKS cluster name or ID.

optional.name: ibmcloud_resource_group
optional.description: IBM Cloud resource group used for cluster discovery. Defaults to the value inherited from the selected IBM Cloud Credential Template, or 'default' if none is provided.

modules.name: ROKS Cluster Register
modules.description: Resolve an existing IBM ROKS cluster and emit BNK registration outputs.
